method: isolated memory storage; production purchases, save manager and procedural recovery admission with recorded formal world
checks: new record starts at one slot; real linear purchases expand it exactly 1→2→3→4
rejected expansion saves restore exact capacity, items, reserve and growth before a successful retry
legacy base 3/4 slots migrate once to schema 2 levels 2/3, keeping weapon and contaminant references
legacy V1 and missing defense field retain the original three slots without creating purchases or rewards
a rejected legacy-base migration leaves old bytes intact and repeated loads/retry never add capacity twice
old active world loads unchanged, then a complete frame commits schema 2 and survives denywrite/reload
old departure intent preserves frozen modifiers and equipment while its next save adopts schema 2
an unfinished old return keeps its receipt until base settlement, then saves migration and settlement together
unsupported schemas and malformed levels reject before live state or stored bytes change
limitations: No player visual acceptance or browser input is claimed.
